evals.name: executive-strategy-deck
evals.prompt: Turn the attached market analysis and operating metrics into a 10-slide executive strategy deck. The audience needs to decide which of three expansion options to fund next quarter. Keep the analysis evidence-grounded and make the trade-offs visually obvious.
evals.expected_output: A decision-oriented deck architecture with conclusion-led slides, explicit comparison criteria, evidence traceability, readable charts or tables, and full-slide QA before delivery.

evals.name: academic-research-poster
evals.prompt: Convert this manuscript into a conference poster for researchers outside my subfield. Preserve the uncertainty and study limitations, but make the primary result understandable in under a minute.
evals.expected_output: A research poster that prioritizes the question, methods, primary result, uncertainty, and limitations without turning the manuscript into tiny text blocks.

evals.name: technical-system-explainer
evals.prompt: Make a polished one-page visual explainer of this distributed system architecture for new engineers. Show the request path, data stores, failure boundaries, and what happens when the primary region is unavailable.
evals.expected_output: A layered technical explainer with clear system boundaries, data/request flow, failure-mode visibility, restrained visual hierarchy, and no irrelevant business or medical framing.

evals.name: training-handbook
evals.prompt: Turn these 30 pages of onboarding notes into a visual field handbook for staff who need to look things up during work rather than read from beginning to end.
evals.expected_output: A retrieval-oriented handbook using task-based navigation, checklists, quick-reference tables, consistent terminology, and a design optimized for lookup rather than linear prose.

evals.name: travel-comparison-report
evals.prompt: Compare these two group itineraries and create a client-facing PDF that makes the practical differences clear: hotels, transfer burden, walking, meals, attraction depth, included value, and realistic downsides.
evals.expected_output: A travel comparison that combines official facts with clearly bounded practical interpretation, uses real subject-specific visuals where available, and does not invent hotel assignments, prices, or inclusions.

evals.name: clinical-teaching-deck
evals.prompt: Create a 20-slide clinical teaching deck from these guidelines and studies. The audience is time-pressured clinicians, so make decision thresholds, timing, doses, contraindications, controversies, and the action sequence easy to see.
evals.expected_output: A clinically accurate, decision-oriented deck with current source verification, exact high-yield values, one dominant message per slide, de-identification, and full-slide visual QA.

evals.name: public-policy-one-pager
evals.prompt: Turn this new municipal policy into a one-page public explainer. Residents need to know who is affected, what changes, key dates, exceptions, and what action to take.
evals.expected_output: A plain-language one-pager with current policy details, dates, exceptions, action steps, accessible hierarchy, and no legal certainty beyond the source material.

evals.name: existing-deck-revision
evals.prompt: This deck is accurate but ugly. Improve the visual hierarchy and readability without changing its successful structure or dropping technical detail. Inspect the whole deck before deciding what to redesign.
evals.expected_output: A conservative revision workflow that preserves working structure, identifies local versus global defects, changes only what is necessary, and rechecks the complete artifact for regressions.
